Home.about_subtitle: Who we are and how we work
Home.about_p1: Dentologia is a dental clinic in Câmpulung Muscel, at 2 General Iosif Teodorescu Street. We treat patients of all ages, from sealants and fluoride treatments for children through to dental implants and full oral rehabilitation.
Home.about_p2: The practice is equipped with modern technology and we work with established manufacturers — Dentsply Sirona zirconia, Emax Ivoclar ceramics, Spark clear aligners. Sterilisation and safety protocols are followed for every procedure.
Home.about_p3: We believe an informed patient is a calm patient. That is why we explain every stage of treatment before we begin, and why our full price list is public — no surprise costs at the end.
